messages:
sasha: uploaded a new 'Rollout Inspector' slate mock — compact left rail with timeline scrub + right pane diff preview. figma -> https://figma.com/file/rollout-inspector
prit: I like the slate idea. one concern: focus management when keyboard-scrubbing between versions — focus should move into the diff pane content so screen reader users get context.
noor: agreed. when you land on a version, aria-live should announce: 'Version v2.7 selected. 25% traffic. 3 regressions detected.' and focus should land on the primary heading inside the diff pane.
eli: small visual nit: the slate uses a 1px outline for the focused tick — low contrast. need at least 3px high-contrast focus ring (or use an outer glow) to meet a11y and touch discoverability.
sasha: good calls. i'll swap to a 3px tokenized focus ring and a subtle shadow for active. also will add an option in prefs for high-contrast focus.
prit: copy nit in the inspector header: change 'Snapshot diff' -> 'Version snapshot & diff' to reduce ambiguity.
noor: rollback flow: current CTA is 'Rollback', but we should avoid single-click destructive actions. propose: 'Open rollback panel' in the action menu, then panel has explicit 'Confirm and rollback traffic' primary and reason dropdown.
eli: add audit-bot note: rollbacks in prod require 2FA and create an audit entry. modal should display 'This action will be audited.' and show the expected audit entry summary.
audit-bot: security reminder: prod rollbacks will be logged with user ID and IP; include 'Requires 2FA' microcopy and a link to the audit log for quick review.
sasha: will include that. question: should we show a small preview of the timeline post-rollback inside the modal? could help users understand immediate effect.
prit: yes, a lightweight preview is helpful but make it read-only and accessible. when preview is focused, aria-live: 'Post-rollback preview: v2.6 will receive 80% traffic.'
noor: keyboard accessibility: left/right arrows for timeline scrub, Space to open selected actions, Enter to open panel, Esc to close. document these in a tiny help tooltip and include in the a11y checklist.
eli: screen reader users will need explicit labels for grouped canaries. e.g., 'Group: mobile experiments (3 variants)'. Provide 'Expand group' button for screen-reader only to reveal variants.
sasha: i'll add group headings and a sr-only expand trigger. also include pattern overlays in the timeline legend (not just color) for colorblind users.
prit: microcopy: change 'Undo available for 5 minutes' -> 'Undo available for 5 minutes after rollout' to avoid ambiguity about what can be undone.
noor: also add a small banner after any rollout/rollback: 'Action executed. View audit log | Undo' with keyboard-focusable links and announced via aria-live.
sasha: great. I'll update the mock: stronger focus ring, aria-live announcements on select/open, rollback panel with audit/2FA copy and preview, grouped canary expanders, pattern legend, keyboard cheat tooltip, and updated microcopy. will post new figma in ~1.5h and add an accessibility handoff checklist in the file comments.
thread_summary: Design review for a Rollout Inspector slate: focus/focus-ring contrast, aria-live announcements for version selection and previews, safer rollback panel with audit/2FA copy and post-rollback preview, keyboard binding doc, grouped canary labels and expanders, pattern legend for colorblindness, and microcopy tweaks for undo wording.
